title: Amore Cost — presentation video
notes: Every peso figure comes from the built-in sample recipes (src/lib/demo.ts) run through the app's own math — same numbers as docs/onboarding/user-manual.md. `say` = what the voice reads (phonetic, pesos spelled out); `caption` = what's on screen. `tl` = the Taglish voiceover for ElevenLabs (see elevenlabs-voiceover-taglish.md); `python3 build.py --taglish` uses it for captions.

scenes.headline: Amore Cost
scenes.sub: Alamin kung may kwenta ang presyo mo.

lines.caption: Meet Amore Cost — the pricing tool built for Filipino food businesses.
lines.say: Meet Ah-moh-reh Cost. The pricing tool built for Filipino food businesses.

tl.caption: Kilalanin ang Amore Cost — ang pricing tool na ginawa para sa Filipino food business.
tl.say: Kilalanin ang Amore Cost. Ang pricing tool na ginawa talaga para sa Filipino food business.

lines.caption: Know if your price is really earning for you.
lines.say: Know whether your price is really earning for you.

tl.caption: Alamin kung may kwenta ang presyo mo.
tl.say: Alamin kung may kwenta ang presyo mo.

scenes.headline: Most small food sellers price by guessing

cards.title: Guess or copy
cards.body: Prices copied from the stall next door

cards.title: Costs go up
cards.body: Ingredient prices rise, menu prices don't

cards.title: Hidden waste
cards.body: Bones, peel and trim are never counted

cards.title: Silent leaks
cards.body: Rent, bills and Senior/PWD discounts eat the profit

lines.caption: Most small food sellers set prices by guessing, or by copying the stall next door.
lines.say: Most small food sellers set prices by guessing, or by copying the stall next door.

tl.caption: Karamihan sa maliliit na food business, hula lang ang presyo — o kinokopya sa katabing stall.
tl.say: Karamihan sa maliliit na food business, hula lang ang presyo... o kinokopya lang sa katabing stall.

lines.caption: Ingredient prices go up, but menu prices stay the same.
lines.say: Ingredient prices go up, but menu prices stay the same.

tl.caption: Tumataas ang presyo ng ingredients, pero ang presyo sa menu, ganun pa rin.
tl.say: Tumataas ang presyo ng ingredients, pero ang presyo sa menu... ganun pa rin.

lines.caption: Waste — like chicken bones — is never counted.
lines.say: Waste, like chicken bones, is never counted.

tl.caption: Yung waste — gaya ng buto ng manok — hindi nabibilang.
tl.say: Yung waste, gaya ng buto ng manok, hindi nabibilang.

lines.caption: And rent, bills and Senior/PWD discounts quietly eat the profit.
lines.say: And rent, bills, and senior citizen and P W D discounts quietly eat the profit.

tl.caption: Tapos ang upa, bills, at Senior/PWD discount — tahimik na kumakain ng kita mo.
tl.say: Tapos ang upa, ang bills, at ang Senior at PWD discount... tahimik na kumakain ng kita mo.

scenes.headline: Built for the way Filipino food businesses work

lines.caption: Amore Cost is made for home bakers, carinderias, food carts and online food sellers.
lines.say: Ah-moh-reh Cost is made for home bakers, carinderias, food carts, and online food sellers across the Philippines.

tl.caption: Ang Amore Cost ay para sa home bakers, carinderia, food carts, at online food sellers.
tl.say: Ang Amore Cost ay para sa mga home baker, carinderia, food cart, at online food seller sa buong Pilipinas.

lines.caption: It's free, there's no sign-up, and it works in English and Tagalog — on your phone or laptop.
lines.say: It's free, there's no sign-up, and it works in English and Tagalog, on your phone or your laptop.

tl.caption: Libre ito, walang sign-up, at may English at Tagalog — sa phone man o laptop.
tl.say: Libre ito, walang sign-up, at may English at Tagalog. Sa phone man o sa laptop.

scenes.headline: Try it with a real carinderia menu
facts: Avg food cost vs. the 28–32% target

lines.caption: Getting started takes one tap: “Try with sample recipes” loads a real carinderia menu.
lines.say: Getting started takes one tap. Try with sample recipes loads a real carinderia menu: chicken adobo, tapsilog, and halo-halo.

tl.caption: Isang tap lang para magsimula: “Try with sample recipes” — may totoong carinderia menu agad: Adobo, Tapsilog, at Halo-Halo.
tl.say: Isang tap lang para magsimula. Pindutin ang Try with sample recipes, at may totoong carinderia menu ka na agad: Adobo, Tapsilog, at Halo-Halo.

lines.caption: The Dashboard shows your recipes, monthly bills, and average food cost against the healthy 28–32% target.
lines.say: The dashboard shows your recipes, your monthly bills, and your average food cost, against the healthy twenty eight to thirty two percent target.

tl.caption: Sa Dashboard, kita mo agad ang recipes mo, monthly bills, at average food cost — kumpara sa healthy target na 28–32%.
tl.say: Sa Dashboard, kita mo agad ang recipes mo, ang monthly bills, at ang average food cost mo... kumpara sa healthy target na twenty-eight to thirty-two percent.

scenes.headline: Every ingredient, including the waste
facts: Recipe in grams, bought by the kilo
One plate of adobo really costs ₱80.08

lines.caption: Each recipe lists what one serving uses. Enter grams even if you buy by the kilo — the app converts it.
lines.say: Each recipe lists what one serving uses. Enter grams, even if you buy by the kilo. The app converts it for you.

tl.caption: Sa bawat recipe, ilagay kung gaano karami ang gamit sa isang serving. Pwede sa grams kahit per kilo ka bumibili — automatic ang convert.
tl.say: Sa bawat recipe, ilalagay mo kung gaano karami ang gamit sa isang serving. Pwede sa grams, kahit per kilo ka bumibili. Automatic ang convert.

lines.caption: Yield counts what you throw away: bone-in chicken at 70% really costs ₱62.86 per plate, not ₱44.
lines.say: Yield counts what you throw away. Chicken with bones, at seventy percent yield, really costs sixty two pesos and eighty six centavos per plate, not forty four.

tl.caption: Binibilang din ng yield ang natatapon: ang manok na may buto, sa 70% yield, ₱62.86 pala per plate — hindi ₱44.
tl.say: Binibilang din ng yield ang natatapon. Ang manok na may buto, sa seventy percent yield... sixty-two pesos and eighty-six centavos pala talaga per plate. Hindi forty-four.

lines.caption: So one plate of adobo truly costs ₱80.08.
lines.say: So one plate of adobo truly costs eighty pesos and eight centavos.

tl.caption: Kaya ang isang plato ng adobo, ₱80.08 ang totoong gastos.
tl.say: Kaya ang isang plato ng adobo, eighty pesos and eight centavos ang totoong gastos.

scenes.headline: A suggested price you can stand behind
facts: Based on the margin you want, VAT included

lines.caption: From that cost, Amore Cost suggests a selling price based on the margin you want — VAT included.
lines.say: From that cost, Ah-moh-reh Cost suggests a selling price based on the margin you want, with VAT included.

tl.caption: Mula diyan, magsa-suggest ang Amore Cost ng tamang presyo base sa margin na gusto mo — kasama na ang VAT.
tl.say: Mula diyan, magsa-suggest ang Amore Cost ng tamang presyo, base sa margin na gusto mo. Kasama na ang VAT.

lines.caption: Round it to a menu-friendly ₱299. It always rounds up, so you never lose margin.
lines.say: Round it to a menu-friendly two hundred ninety nine pesos. It always rounds up, so you never lose margin.

tl.caption: I-round sa ₱299 para maganda sa menu. Laging pataas ang round, kaya hindi nababawasan ang margin mo.
tl.say: I-round mo sa two hundred ninety-nine pesos, para maganda tingnan sa menu. Laging pataas ang round, kaya hindi nababawasan ang margin mo.

lines.caption: It even shows the correct Senior/PWD price: ₱213.57.
lines.say: It even shows the correct senior and P W D price. Two hundred thirteen pesos and fifty seven centavos.

tl.caption: Pati ang tamang Senior/PWD price, nandiyan na: ₱213.57.
tl.say: Pati ang tamang Senior at PWD price, nandiyan na. Two hundred thirteen pesos and fifty-seven centavos.

scenes.headline: Change a price once, every recipe updates

lines.caption: Keep your ingredients in one shared library.
lines.say: Keep your ingredients in one shared library.

tl.caption: Lahat ng ingredients mo, nasa isang Ingredient Library.
tl.say: Lahat ng ingredients mo, nasa iisang Ingredient Library.

lines.caption: When chicken jumps from ₱220 to ₱300 a kilo at the palengke, change it once — every recipe updates.
lines.say: When chicken jumps from two hundred twenty to three hundred pesos a kilo at the palengke, change it once, and every recipe updates.

tl.caption: Pag tumaas ang manok sa palengke, from ₱220 to ₱300 per kilo — isang beses mo lang palitan, update na lahat ng recipe.
tl.say: Pag tumaas ang manok sa palengke, from two hundred twenty to three hundred pesos per kilo... isang beses mo lang palitan, update na lahat ng recipe.

scenes.headline: Know what each plate must earn back

lines.caption: Next, add your monthly bills: rent, electricity, LPG, salaries and ads.
lines.say: Next, add your monthly bills. Rent, electricity, L P G, salaries, and ads.

tl.caption: Next, ilagay ang monthly bills mo: upa, kuryente, LPG, sahod, at ads.
tl.say: Next, ilagay ang monthly bills mo. Upa, kuryente, L-P-G, sahod, at ads.

lines.caption: ₱52,700 a month across 1,500 dishes means every plate must earn back ₱35.13.
lines.say: Fifty two thousand seven hundred pesos a month, across fifteen hundred dishes, means every plate must earn back thirty five pesos and thirteen centavos.

tl.caption: ₱52,700 kada buwan, hatiin sa 1,500 dishes — bawat plato, kailangang kumita ng ₱35.13 para sa bills.
tl.say: Fifty-two thousand seven hundred pesos kada buwan, hatiin sa fifteen hundred dishes... ibig sabihin, bawat plato kailangang kumita ng thirty-five pesos and thirteen centavos para sa bills.

scenes.headline: See exactly what the customer pays

lines.caption: The Receipt Simulator shows exactly what a customer pays.
lines.say: The receipt simulator shows exactly what a customer pays.

tl.caption: Sa Receipt Simulator, kita mo eksakto kung magkano ang babayaran ng customer.
tl.say: Sa Receipt Simulator, kita mo eksakto kung magkano ang babayaran ng customer.

lines.caption: Two adobo and one halo-halo come to ₱788. For a senior citizen, VAT comes off first, then 20% — the correct total is ₱562.86.
lines.say: Two adobo and one halo-halo come to seven hundred eighty eight pesos. For a senior citizen, VAT comes off first, then twenty percent. The correct total is five hundred sixty two pesos and eighty six centavos.

tl.caption: Dalawang adobo at isang halo-halo: ₱788. Pag senior citizen, unang tinatanggal ang VAT, saka ang 20% — kaya ₱562.86 ang tamang total.
tl.say: Dalawang adobo at isang halo-halo: seven hundred eighty-eight pesos. Pag senior citizen, unang tinatanggal ang VAT, saka ang twenty percent. Kaya five hundred sixty-two pesos and eighty-six centavos ang tamang total.

lines.caption: And you see what you really keep from every order.
lines.say: And you see what you really keep from every order.

tl.caption: At kita mo rin kung magkano talaga ang naiuuwi mo sa bawat order.
tl.say: At kita mo rin kung magkano talaga ang naiuuwi mo sa bawat order.

scenes.headline: Does this price pay the bills?
facts: Try any price and monthly volume
About 10 a day — even if adobo pays every bill

lines.caption: Finally, the Margin & POS Simulator answers the big question: does this price pay the bills?
lines.say: Finally, the margin and P O S simulator answers the big question. Does this price pay the bills?

tl.caption: Panghuli, sinasagot ng Margin & POS Simulator ang malaking tanong: kaya ba ng presyong ito ang bills mo?
tl.say: Panghuli, sinasagot ng Margin and POS Simulator ang malaking tanong. Kaya ba ng presyong ito ang bills mo?

lines.caption: Even if adobo alone paid every bill, you'd break even at 282 plates a month — about 10 a day.
lines.say: Even if adobo alone paid every bill, you'd break even at two hundred eighty two plates a month. That's about ten a day.

tl.caption: Kahit adobo lang ang magbayad ng lahat ng bills, break-even ka na sa 282 plato kada buwan — mga 10 lang kada araw.
tl.say: Kahit adobo lang ang magbayad ng lahat ng bills, break-even ka na sa two hundred eighty-two plato kada buwan. Mga sampu lang kada araw!

scenes.headline: What Amore Cost gives your business

cards.title: Price with confidence
cards.body: A real number, not a guess

cards.title: Protect your margin
cards.body: Spot it the day costs rise

lines.caption: With Amore Cost, you price with confidence and protect your margin when costs rise…
lines.say: With Ah-moh-reh Cost, you price with confidence, and protect your margin when costs rise.

tl.caption: Sa Amore Cost, sigurado ka sa presyo mo, at protektado ang margin mo kahit tumaas ang gastos…
tl.say: Sa Amore Cost, sigurado ka sa presyo mo, at protektado ang margin mo kahit tumaas ang gastos.

lines.caption: …handle VAT and Senior/PWD discounts correctly, and know your break-even before you open.
lines.say: You handle VAT and senior discounts correctly, and you know your break-even before you open.

tl.caption: …tama ang VAT at Senior/PWD discount, at alam mo ang break-even mo bago ka pa magbukas.
tl.say: Tama ang VAT at ang Senior discount, at alam mo na ang break-even mo, bago ka pa magbukas.

scenes.kicker: Works with the POS you already use
scenes.headline:
Price it in Amore Cost.
Sell it in your POS.

lines.caption: Already using a POS? Keep it. Price it in Amore Cost, then sell it in your POS.
lines.say: Already using a P O S? Keep it. Price it in Ah-moh-reh Cost, then sell it in your P O S.

tl.caption: May POS ka na? Ituloy mo lang. I-presyo sa Amore Cost, saka ibenta sa POS mo.
tl.say: May POS ka na? Ituloy mo lang. I-presyo mo sa Amore Cost, saka ibenta sa POS mo.

lines.caption: Try it free at amore-cost.vercel.app — know if your price is really earning.
lines.say: Try it free at amore cost dot vercel dot app. Ah-moh-reh Cost. Know if your price is really earning.

tl.caption: Subukan nang libre sa amore-cost.vercel.app — alamin kung may kwenta ang presyo mo.
tl.say: Subukan nang libre sa amore cost dot vercel dot app. Amore Cost... alamin kung may kwenta ang presyo mo.
